verdict.rationale: The Jules API covers the core agent loop. It can create sessions and custom workflows (jules-docs-9, jules-docs-16), send messages to the agent (jules-docs-12), approve plans (jules-docs-17), and control automatic PR creation via `automationMode` (jules-docs-11), and a community user built an MCP bridge that dispatches tasks through it (jules-comm-19). Parity is not demonstrated, though: API keys can only be created in the web app's Settings page (jules-docs-10), and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (jules-probe-3). Missing for 10: an explicit or documented UI/API parity claim, API-based key and settings management, API equivalents for diff review and GitHub-label assignment, and a published OpenAPI spec.
